data.command: $tag='aiw-say-fd036-r5-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); $testExe=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'.exe'); $env:GOCACHE=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'-cache'); $env:GOPROXY='off'; $env:GOSUMDB='off'; $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'; go build -o $testExe ./cmd/aiw-say; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'go build failed' }; $env:AIW_SAY_BIN=$testExe; python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox
data.scope: Temporary compile of ./cmd/aiw-say followed by the focused root black-box module tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox. Covers TOML syntax rejection for Go-only escape, unknown array key ignoring, invalid value and type fallback, and existing CLI/config behavior.
data.side_effects: Creates one random executable and a dedicated Go build cache under %TEMP%; tests create and clean Python TemporaryDirectory paths and bind an HTTP mock to 127.0.0.1. No repository output, dependency downloads, real API, external network, or system configuration writes.
data.risk_review: Focused, offline, inspectable, and confined to one test module plus unique temporary paths. GOPROXY and GOSUMDB are off; Python bytecode writes are disabled. One execution only.
